audit.whatIsWrong: Six of the seven phase reasons are still shared template text, and report[5] both names the wrong ability and calls Lillia 'his'.
audit.why: Blooming Blows is 6s at rank 1, Watch Out! Eep! 14s, Swirlseed 12s and Lilting Lullaby 150s — the stages turn on those, not on a generic chip war.
audit.corrected: phases[0], [2], [3], [4], [5] and [6] rewritten around Dream Dust, the Q edge and the sleep, in second person.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 said only 'her ultimate changes the math too', with no statement of what actually changes.
audit.why: Lilting Lullaby is 150s at rank 1 and only reaches enemies already carrying Dream Dust, so her level 6 spike depends entirely on whether she has landed a spell on you first.
audit.corrected: phases[4] now states the Dream Dust precondition and the 150s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The condition that decides her ultimate was never stated anywhere: Lilting Lullaby only affects enemies with Dream Dust on them, so if she has not landed a spell on you, the sleep does nothing.
audit.why: Riot's descriptions: Dream-Laden Bough — 'Hitting a champion or monster with a skill will deal additional max Health damage over time'; Lilting Lullaby — 'Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep'. Also missing: Blooming Blows deals extra true damage on its outer edge, so the rim of her Q is the worst place to stand.
audit.corrected: The Dream Dust precondition is in phases[4].why, dontsFull[0].d and report[5].t; the true-damage edge in phases[2].why and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Swirlseed's 12s and the ultimate's 150s are already on the page, but the two cooldowns you actually trade against are missing.
audit.why: Blooming Blows is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4 and Watch Out! Eep! 14/13/12/11/10 — those are what she throws in a real exchange, and both are far shorter than anything currently named.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into phases[2].why, phases[3].why and dosFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad and all three dontsFull descriptions are still the shared template, and report[5] names Blooming Blows while describing 'his answer'.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten to their own titles, with the right pronoun.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Identify how Lillia contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Swirlseed reaches 700 and rolls until it hits something, so she chips you from outside your 550. Farm and take nothing.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Lillia must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Blooming Blows is on 6s and its outer edge adds true damage — stand on her or stand well clear.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade on Swirlseed's 12s cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: Watch Out! Eep! is 14s at rank 1 and hits hardest dead centre — step through her, not around her.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Lillia's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby (150s) only sleeps enemies already carrying Dream Dust — deny her the spell hit and her level 6 does nothing.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Lilting Lullaby's 150s.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force the fight while her ultimate is still on that 150s.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Lillia carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and one rotation kills her, but her max-health chip and speed stacks kite a stalled game — close it out.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Fighting with Dream Dust already on you — her sleep lands, and the wake-up hit is amplified.

edits.before: Q Lillia at max blade range, E-dash the angle while Swirlseed's 12s is burning, and shroud the poke.
edits.after: Her Blooming Blows is only 6s at rank 1 — poke on your energy regen, not on every step she takes.

edits.before: That is Lillia's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.
edits.after: With Dream Dust on you her ultimate sleeps you; clean, it reaches nothing.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Her Q edge adds true damage, so the rim is the worst place.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Perfect Execution is 120s at rank 1 — cast one is not poke, it is half of your kill window.

edits.before: Track Lillia's Blooming Blows: Her kite + move speed stacks. When it is down — Shroud his answer, Q-burst.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby only reaches enemies carrying Dream Dust — deny her the spell hit and the sleep finds nothing.

notes: Only 14 recorded games at Emerald+, so the 47.93% figure carries almost no weight — I wrote nothing that depends on it and would treat this page's HARD rating as provisional. report[5] previously named Blooming Blows while describing 'his answer'; both are fixed. Part of this matchup had already been improved on disk (phases[1], winCon, tldr, breakdown.cooldowns, tradeGood, dosFull[0], dosFull[2]) between my first read and my write, so I edited only the paths still holding template text.
